question.text: Can medical students contribute to quality assurance programmes in day surgery?

medgemma_4b.clinical_reasoning: Medical students can contribute to quality assurance programs in day surgery by assisting with tasks such as data collection, chart review, and observation of surgical procedures. This can help improve the efficiency and accuracy of the program, and provide valuable learning opportunities for the students.
medgemma_4b.critical_evidence: Medical students can contribute to quality assurance programs in day surgery.
medgemma_4b.differential_considered: Medical students may not have the necessary experience or training to independently assess surgical quality. However, with proper supervision and guidance, they can be valuable assets to a quality assurance program.
